title: November 25 — the inward head: from grain to independent evidence
summary: Two new repositories, one major Theory continuation. Reading geometry does not imply useful writeback; adaptive association fails, independent evidence improves RAT.

nodes.claim: Unlabeled PCA taxonomy reading against matched random directions.
nodes.survived: K1 passes on three checkpoints; d16 purity 0.335/0.321/0.280 vs random 0.260/0.238/0.207. Exploratory lid removal restores late-layer advantage.
nodes.killed: K3 fails all three; one taxonomy, Qwen extension descriptive; Bridge and Ocular do not establish intervention benefit.
nodes.era: November 25: the inward head and separate evidence

nodes.claim: Frozen Qwen continuous embedding feedback with adaptive layer/PCA aperture and omitted-state residue.
nodes.survived: Two-concept pilot recurrence fixed .988, adaptive .568, residue .494; reset pre-intervention agreement.
nodes.killed: Full gate incomplete; one trial per concept, aperture saturation, no semantic benefit established.

motifs.title: Separate observations before combining evidence
motifs.description: Reading is not writing; movement regulation is not task progress. Independent cue evidence improves this RAT benchmark, without proving a general cognitive law.
